# debian/sway/packages.txt - the sway desktop, on top of
# debian/common/packages.txt. Only what is needed and proven on the tablet.
#
sway                    # the desktop: tiling Wayland compositor
swaybg                  # wallpaper
swayidle                # dims and switches the screen off when idle
foot                    # terminal
fuzzel                  # application launcher (Super+d)
libgl1-mesa-dri         # GPU driver (Mesa, Panfrost)
libegl1                 # GPU interface (EGL)
libgles2                # GPU interface (OpenGL ES)
fonts-dejavu-core       # DejaVu fonts
fonts-terminus-otb      # Terminus font for sway and foot
iio-sensor-proxy        # accelerometer for screen rotation (autorotate.sh)
imv                     # image viewer (command: imv-wayland)
xdg-utils               # xdg-open: open a file or link with its program
